- Python 3.13, `uv`
- WSL/Linux sandbox for runs (never run with secrets on an untrusted host)
- Optional: any OpenAI-compatible LLM API key (`MODEL` default `claude-haiku`, 1 LLM call per repo)

```bash

cd ~/neathack/readme-liar-detector
uv venv --python 3.13 .venv && uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python -U -r requirements.txt
printf 'LLM_API_KEY=...\n' > .env
export LLM_BASE_URL=https://your-llm-provider/v1 MODEL=claude-haiku
export LIAR_EXTRA_PATH=/home/you/neathack/opt/node/bin  # Linux-only dir, never /mnt/*
```

| Var | Purpose | Default |
| --- | --- | ------- |

"""Parse README into verifiable claims: commands, env keys, ports, links."""
import re
from pathlib import Path

CMD_RE = re.compile(r"```(\w*)\n(.*?)```", re.S)
SHELL_LANGS = {"", "bash", "sh", "shell", "console", "text", "plaintext", "terminal", "zsh"}
INLINE_RE = re.compile(r"`(npm run [^`]+|npm install|pip install[^`]*|python[^`]*|node[^`]+)`")
ENV_RE = re.compile(r"\b([A-Z][A-Z0-9_]{3,})\b")
PORT_RE = re.compile(r"(?::|port\s+|localhost:)(\d{2,5})", re.I)
LINK_RE = re.compile(r"https?://[^\s\]\)\"'(]+")

def parse_readme(path: str | Path) -> dict:
    text = Path(path).read_text(encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore")
    # Only shell-tagged (or untagged) blocks are executable commands.
    # rust/python/etc. blocks are usage samples, never run.
    blocks = [m.group(2) for m in CMD_RE.finditer(text)
              if (m.group(1) or "").lower() in SHELL_LANGS]
    code_blocks = [m.group(2) for m in CMD_RE.finditer(text)]
    cmds = []
    for b in blocks:
        for line in b.splitlines():
            line = line.strip().lstrip("$ ").strip()
            if line and not line.startswith("#"):
                cmds.append(line)
    inline = [m.group(1).strip() for m in INLINE_RE.finditer(text)]
    for c in inline:
        if c not in cmds:
            cmds.append(c)
    # Backticked ALL_CAPS tokens are code (env keys); prose stays out.
    ticked = re.findall(r"`([A-Z][A-Z0-9_]{3,})`", text)
    # Env keys only from code (all blocks + inline), never prose: avoids
    # false positives like NOT/ONLY/PATH from sentences.
    code_text = "\n".join(code_blocks + inline + ticked)
    return {
        "commands": cmds[:10],  # cap for $20 budget / time
        "env_keys": sorted(set(ENV_RE.findall(code_text)))[:20],
        "ports": sorted(set(PORT_RE.findall(text)))[:10],
        "links": sorted({u.rstrip(".,;:!?)") for u in LINK_RE.findall(text)})[:10],
    }

if __name__ == "__main__":
    import sys, json
    print(json.dumps(parse_readme(sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "golden/README.md"), indent=2))

def fix_npm_missing_file(cmd: str, workdir: str, pkg: dict) -> str | None:
    parts = cmd.strip().split()
    if len(parts) != 3 or parts[0] != "npm" or parts[1] != "run":
        return None
    script = pkg.get("scripts", {}).get(parts[2], "")
    toks = script.strip().split()
    if len(toks) != 2 or toks[0] != "node" or not toks[1].endswith(".js"):
        return None
    target = os.path.realpath(os.path.join(workdir, toks[1]))
    root = os.path.realpath(workdir)
    if os.path.commonpath([root, target]) != root:
        return None  # never write outside workdir
    if os.path.exists(target):
